project_type: Node/Express REST API backend + React 19 / Vite SPA frontend, monorepo with separate backend/ and frontend/ workspaces
language: JavaScript (backend CommonJS, frontend ESM with JSX)
build_system: frontend: Vite (npm run dev / npm run build in frontend/); backend: Node.js with nodemon (npm run dev in backend/). No monorepo root build script that covers both simultaneously.
test_framework: None discovered (no jest/vitest/mocha config found). Verification is done by running the dev server and confirming no console errors.
test_command: cd frontend && npm run build   (catches JSX/import errors at compile time)
verification_instructions: 1. cd frontend && npm run build — must exit 0 with no errors. 2. Start backend: cd backend && npm run dev. 3. Start frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev. 4. Log in as a CLIENT user; confirm the /client route shows the sidebar layout and all nav links work.
environment_constraints: Windows host (PowerShell). Paths use backslashes in shell but forward slashes in JS imports. Never import from outside frontend/src with relative paths longer than three levels.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Follow existing code style: functional React components, useState/useEffect, async/await, Tailwind utility classes, no CSS files. Backend uses CommonJS require/module.exports.
key_patterns: Backend: authenticate + authorize('ROLE') middleware applied via router.use() for role-locked routers, or per-route for mixed-role routers. Frontend: NavLink with isActive callback for active state styling (see Sidebar.jsx). Teal color brand for client portal (#0D9488 / teal-600). Primary blue (#2563EB) for therapist portal. API import: `import api from '../../api/axios'`. Auth: `import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext'`. lucide-react for all icons.
directory_structure: Unfazed/ (root, package.json workspace config) | backend/src/app.js (Express app, all routes registered here) | backend/src/routes/ (one file per domain) | backend/src/controllers/ (one file per domain) | backend/src/models/ (Mongoose schemas) | backend/src/middleware/auth.js (JWT authenticate) | backend/src/middleware/rbac.js (authorize('ROLE')) | frontend/src/routes/AppRoutes.jsx (all React Router routes) | frontend/src/layouts/ (TherapistLayout, ClientLayout, PublicLayout) | frontend/src/pages/client/ (client-only pages) | frontend/src/components/common/ (Button, Badge, Sidebar, Navbar, Modal)
